title: Can DPO Learn Diverse Human Values? A Theoretical Scaling Law

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model generalization and reward margins using Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) on distinct political personas (e.g., politically conservative, anti-immigration, believes in gun rights) from the Anthropic Persona dataset.

Evaluating model generalization and reward margins using Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) on moral framework personas (e.g., rule utilitarianism, moral intuitions) from the Anthropic Persona dataset.

Evaluating model generalization and reward margins using Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) on personality trait personas (e.g., agreeableness, risk-aversion, extraversion, machiavellianism) from the Anthropic Persona dataset.
